question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

Today she said to her friend, “You’re the sweetest person I have met ever”.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the placement of the word** "ever".**
 
• In English, the correct placement would be **"I have ever met" instead of "I have met ever".**
 
• The correct phrase should be** "I have ever met", **ensuring **grammatical correctness and clarity.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

**Correct Sentence:** ***"Today she said to her friend, "You’re the sweetest person I have ever met.__"***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "the sweetest person,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "Today she said to,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "her friend, “You’re,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **No error** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 1.
